note: Both backends start from the original machine state exported at sync_frame (Genesis Plus GX profiling core) and play the same inputs. Bot runs (tools/bot-play.py) stop their RAM-write aids before the sync frame: round1-bot and round1-bot-gameover at 11000, round1-bot-clear at 14800, round1-bot-throws at 3500, round1-bot-items at 15800, round1-bot-bat at 14000, two-player-bot-continue at 23800 (player 1 only); two-player-bot and round1-bot-join use none. Host-owned RAM (incremental Nemesis state, code table, stack below the main loop frame) is excluded from game_ram; unsettled frames are captures where both sides are mid-update or mid-load (mailbox 0).
